row.body: The fuel receipt shows the pump opened for a fleet pickup, but the key ring is logged back before the driver signed out.
row.title: The fuel receipt

sidecar.gloss: The vehicle key returns before its driver checks out.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could refuel a vehicle and return its key early; the log does not explain why the driver was delayed.

row.body: opposite route arrows are painted on the loose badge and folded road map. the older arrow was scraped away beneath fresh road grit.
row.title: missing count beside the loose badge

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
